principle: Inventory is the loaded dataset; a map, Network, or query defines the current working set; the drawer presents that working set.
owner: App.jsx owns ephemeral inventorySession; InventoryPanel renders it and updates it through a controlled setter.

state.persistence: In-memory UI state only; not part of towers, Plan snapshot, ScenarioRevision, request payload, or result fingerprint.

defaultScope: Network when planningMode is Network, otherwise Search / Filter. A user's chosen scope remains selected while the current workspace context is unchanged.

scopeContracts.network: Live resolution of current selectedNetworkTowerIds, preserving current request order.
scopeContracts.map-area: Snapshot of Cell IDs inside current map bounds; explicit Refresh area updates it.
scopeContracts.search: Identity query and resolved-technology filter over currently loaded towers; empty criteria return no rows.

cellOpen: Sets only inventoryTargetCellId; it does not change selectedTower, selectedNetworkTowerIds, selectedMapCellId, inspection state, or compute requests.
editing: Position/profile changes use existing App callbacks and invalidate results; no RF task starts automatically.
